# Rokid Phone Mirroring — upstream CI snapshot

Unmodified development APKs from [pcoronaf/Rockid-mirror](https://github.com/pcoronaf/Rockid-mirror), mirrored here for installation through RokidBrew. This is a community-hosted snapshot, not an official upstream release.

- Upstream commit: `769b2162909b1a71b276e80e20bf6a7c5f413c69`.
- Both APKs come from the same successful [upstream CI run](https://github.com/pcoronaf/Rockid-mirror/actions/runs/38122668438).
- `rokid-phone-mirroring-phone-769b216.apk`: Android phone sender, Android 10+.
- `rokid-phone-mirroring-glasses-769b216.apk`: glasses receiver, Android 12+.
- APK version: `0.1.0`, versionCode `1`. Both use upstream CI debug signatures. Future builds may need an uninstall/reinstall if upstream changes its debug signing certificate; this can remove saved pairing/settings.

Install both apps, connect the phone and glasses to the same Wi-Fi network or phone hotspot, open the receiver, and pair from the phone using the displayed code. The upstream project documents hardware testing on RG-glasses with a Samsung Galaxy S25; this mirrored snapshot has not been tested on hardware by RokidBrew.

The matching complete project source archive, `LICENSE.txt`, and `NOTICE.txt` are attached. The project is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later; third-party attribution is retained in the source and notice. Build instructions are in the source README. The APK files have not been modified or re-signed.

This snapshot is pinned. Updates require another verified upstream build; no automatic CI update tracking is configured.

## About
Phone and glasses app pair for screen mirroring, zoom/pan, pointer controls, and an extended workspace over an encrypted local-network connection. Install the phone sender on Android 10+ and the receiver on Android 12+ glasses, then pair on the same Wi-Fi network or phone hotspot. The upstream project documents sustained playback on RG-glasses with a Galaxy S25. This is an unmodified upstream CI development build, pinned to commit 769b216; RokidBrew has not tested this snapshot on hardware. Both APKs use debug signatures, so future upstream builds may require reinstalling if their signing certificates change. Source and GPL-3.0-or-later license are included with the download.

## Setup
1. Install both APKs on their respective devices.
2. Open the glasses receiver and connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi network or phone hotspot.
3. Connect from the phone sender and enter the code shown on the glasses.
4. Choose whole-screen or single-app mirroring and approve Android screen capture.

## Development snapshot
This download mirrors [upstream CI run 38122668438](https://github.com/pcoronaf/Rockid-mirror/actions/runs/38122668438). It is pinned and does not track future CI builds automatically.

[Matching source, GPL license, and third-party notice](https://github.com/Anezium/RokidBrew-Registry/releases/tag/rokid-phone-mirroring-ci-769b216).
